page.layout: One page of text: running head at top; a heading line below it; a framed woodcut (ornamental border with empty centre) in the middle; a verse block with a large initial below the frame; a catchword-like word "Homo" at the lower right.

l.i: Tollito: depictum sic tibi tempus erit.
Tempore nanque nihil currit velocius vno,
Nec semel elapsum quo reuocetur habet.

page.notes: The running head is set in large capitals; the heading line reads "XXXXIII" as printed (the numeral appears to be XXXIII, with the first letters partly unclear). The large initial "A" is joined to "Dde" as printed. The verse line "Ceruo" is the continuation of the first verse line, set in italic. Ornamental frame with no printed text inside. Some words in the verse are uncertain due to the italic long-s forms; the ligature "s" was read as "s", and "Ꝯ" as "vno" as printed. Lower-right "Homo" is treated as a catchword.
